preplan_feasibility_note: Only declared catalog schema, pre-cutoff row counts, and sample auction record structure were inspected while selecting a materially distinct mechanism; no campaign outcome, signal return, ranking, or backtest was computed.

auction_contract.cross_check: Matching O opening trade on same exchange, price, and size
auction_contract.primary_selection: Largest matched official opening size; reject ambiguous ties

corporate_action_contract.rule: Reject opening/prior-close ratios within 3% of common integer split factors 1:2 through 1:25 or reverse

readiness.causality_rule: Rank on auction, prior data, and exact 09:30/09:31 bars only; later exit availability is post-signal attrition and cannot change ranks
readiness.sparse_bar_rule: Missing later SIP trade minutes mean no eligible trade print; preserve actual trade highs, require exact horizon exit marks, and use quotes for survivors
